cadence.zh: 每年 4 次按 SEC 13F 法定披露截止日调仓

formula.en: 35% SPY + 35% QQQ + 30% Monopoly Compounders Top-10 (Rebalanced 4×/yr on T+45)
formula.zh: 35% SPY + 35% QQQ + 30% 垄断复利6大师 Top-10（每年4次法定日再平衡）

whyItWorks.en: Highest risk-adjusted IR (0.96) with 1.10 Sharpe: captures Nasdaq/S&P beta with the lowest daily max drawdown (-33.6%, beating SPY -33.7% and QQQ -35.1%) while harvesting low-decay monopoly alpha.
whyItWorks.zh: 全测试最高信息比 (0.96) 与高夏普比 (1.10)：70%宽基锁住国运Beta，30%低衰减垄断复利大师贡献纯Alpha，日频最大回撤仅 -33.6%（优于标普 -33.7% 与纳指 -35.1%），心态最稳。

name.zh: 垄断复利 6 大师核心 Top-10

formula.en: TCI · Sanders · PRIMECAP · Marshfield · Windacre · Sachem Head (Rank ≤ 6, Weight ≥ 4%, Conviction-Weighted Top-10)
formula.zh: TCI · Sanders · PRIMECAP · Marshfield · Windacre · Sachem Head（前6重仓且≥4%，信念加权 Top-10）

whyItWorks.en: Ultra-low turnover compounders hold 3–5+ years, retaining 88%–107% of their alpha after the 45-day SEC lag (20.11% CAGR through 2026-11-17). Toggle Equal-Weight for a 74.0% quarterly win rate.
whyItWorks.zh: 低换手垄断复利大师平均持股3–5年以上，45天披露滞后几乎不损耗超额（截至 2026-11-17 年化仍高达 20.11%）；切换等权版季度跑赢标普胜率高达 74.0%。

formula.en: 12 Gurus Already World-Famous Before 2014 (Buffett, Hohn, Druckenmiller, Tepper, Ackman, PRIMECAP, Sanders, etc.) Top-12 Equal-Weight
formula.zh: 仅用 2014 年前已享誉华尔街的 12 位老牌名将（含巴菲特/阿克曼等后来跑输者），前6重仓共识 Top-12 等权

whyItWorks.en: Eliminates survivorship bias completely: even keeping Berkshire and Pershing Square inside the pool, core Top-6 consensus beats SPY in BOTH 2014–19 (+2.18%) and 2020–26 (+3.29%).
whyItWorks.zh: 彻底排除幸存者偏差：即便把后来跑输标普的巴菲特和阿克曼原封保留在池内，前6重仓共识仍在 2014–19 (+2.18%) 与 2020–26 (+3.29%) 上下半场双杀标普！

name.zh: 大师新建仓与猛加仓催化

formula.en: Tracks Only Fresh Convictions Where QoQ Portfolio Weight Jumped ≥ +1.5% (Resulting Weight ≥ 2.5%), Top-12 Equal-Weight
formula.zh: 只抄当季单票仓位环比猛增 Δwt ≥ +1.5%（且总仓位 ≥ 2.5%）的新建仓与重手加仓股，Top-12 等权

whyItWorks.en: Captures multi-quarter institutional accumulation waves (e.g., Duquesne/Tepper AI memory & semi cap-equip cycles) with +4.21%/yr post-2020 alpha and -40.3% daily max drawdown.
whyItWorks.zh: 精准捕捉顶级大师基本面拐点建仓周期（机构建满大仓往往横跨2–3个季度），2020–26年化超额高达 +4.21%，日频最大回撤 -40.3%。

name.zh: HF-4 聪明钱三因子共振 Top-15

formula.en: 2,092 Active HFs Net Inflow (50%) + 59 Multi-Strat Pods Resonance (30%) − 123 Passive Crowding (20%), ≥$5B Cap Top-15
formula.zh: 2,092家主动HF净买占比 (50%) + 59家多策略Pod同向加仓 (30%) − 123家被动指数拥挤度 (20%)，≥$50亿市值 Top-15

whyItWorks.en: Raw HF Q5 buying underperforms SPY, because 80% of raw HF alpha is shorting Q1 dumps. Requiring Pod resonance + Anti-Passive upgrades pure-long T+45 CAGR to 15.89% (-40.7% daily MDD).
whyItWorks.zh: 无脑抄主动HF净买入(Q5)长期跑输标普！叠加多策略Pod共振确认与反被动拥挤过滤后，纯多头严格T+45年化跃升至 15.89%（日频最大回撤 -40.7%）。

title.zh: 死穴一：看近3年收益榜追热榜大师

lesson.en: Walk-forward selecting top-15 active managers by trailing 3-year IR lagged SPY by -5.72%/yr in 2020–2026 due to style mean-reversion. Select low-turnover structural moats, never 3-year hot hands.
lesson.zh: 每季滚动选过去3年IR最高的前15名经理，在2020–2026年化跑输标普 -5.72%！原因正是风格均值回归（刚登顶即迎风格逆风）。选大师看低换手垄断商业模式，绝不追3年冠军榜。

title.en: Trap #2: Blindly Buying Only T+45 Underwater Guru Stocks
title.zh: 死穴二：日常每季只买「T+45跌破大师成本」的破发股

lesson.en: Mechanically buying only guru picks trading below Q-avg at every T+45 yielded 11.28% (-2.18% vs SPY, 42.0% win rate) — adverse selection skips winners and catches broken theses. Use discount-to-guru ONLY during systemic market panics!
lesson.zh: 在平稳牛市里每季机械只挑跌破大师均价的票，年化仅 11.28%（跑输标普 -2.18%，胜率仅 42.0%）——本质是逆向淘汰漏掉主升浪牛股、专接基本面恶化飞刀！「抄大师折价底」仅限全市场系统性恐慌大跌时对核心复利股使用！

title.en: Trap #3: Holding Q1 Stocks Being Heavily Dumped by Active HFs
title.zh: 死穴三：死扛主动对冲基金集中狂抛的 Q1 雷区股

lesson.en: Stocks in the bottom 20% of Active-HF net selling delivered just 7.30% CAGR (-6.84%/yr behind SPY; $100k grew to $237k vs $505k SPY). Always cross-check single-guru picks against the Q1 HF-Dumping Radar!
lesson.zh: 主动对冲基金净抛售最猛的20%股票池（Q1组），12年严格T+45年化仅 7.30%（年化跑输标普 -6.84%，$10万仅变$23.7万 vs 标普$50.5万）！抄任何单一大师作业前必须先过一遍 Q1 聪明钱排雷榜！
